panels.title: Spans per minute
panels.description: From the 5-minute rollup, not the raw table. Real-time aggregation means the newest bucket includes rows that arrived since the last refresh.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time, sum(spans) AS spans
FROM spans_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Org-wide. When this spikes it is almost never everything -- it is a retry storm in one agent. See the table below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time,
       100.0 * sum(errors) / NULLIF(sum(spans), 0) AS error_pct
FROM spans_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: p99 latency by agent
panels.description: Merged percentile sketches. You cannot average a p99 -- rollup() merges the sketches so this number is actually correct.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time, agent_name,
       approx_percentile(0.99, rollup(latency)) AS p99_ms
FROM spans_1h
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND operation = 'chat'
GROUP BY bucket, agent_name
HAVING sum(spans) > 50
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Spend by tenant
panels.description: The question your trace vendor cannot answer after its retention window closes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tenant, round(sum(cost_usd), 2) AS cost_usd
FROM spans_1d
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Distinct conversations per day
panels.description: hyperloglog, grouped only by day. The same sketch grouped four ways took 5,590ms; this takes about 1ms.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time, distinct_count(conversations) AS conversations
FROM conversations_1d
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Retry storms — runs costing 40x the median
panels.description: Hunts the raw table on purpose -- this is the one question worth paying a full scan for. A normal run is ~28 spans and fails 1.5% of the time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT trace_id, agent_name, tenant,
         max(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE parent_span_id IS NULL) AS run_cost,
         count(*) AS spans,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'error') AS errors
  FROM spans
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  GROUP BY trace_id, agent_name, tenant
), m AS (
  SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY run_cost) AS med FROM runs
)
SELECT agent_name, tenant, spans,
       round(100.0 * errors / spans, 1) AS error_pct,
       round(run_cost, 4) AS cost_usd
FROM runs, m
WHERE run_cost > 40 * m.med
ORDER BY run_cost DESC
LIMIT 20
